panels.title: Tokens per minute, right now
panels.description: The sum of input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read_tokens and cache_write_tokens on kind=model_call Events in the trailing 5 minutes, divided by 5, across every active Session that matches the pickers. A fixed 5-minute window, not the dashboard time range, so this reads the current rate even when the picker is set to look further back. The `or (... * 0)` term reports a true zero when no call landed in the last 5 minutes, and no Event is fabricated. The noValue field backs that up with a literal 0 when Loki returns no matching stream at all. If the stored Events include a replayed capture, several log lines share one near-identical timestamp, so a rate figure over that stretch reads far higher than any live Session could produce; the same panel reads correctly once a live Session is running.

targets.expr: (sum(sum_over_time({service_name=~".+", agent=~"$agent", project=~"$project", session_id=~"$session_id", run_id=~"$run_id", task=~"$task", variant=~"$variant", session_label=~"$session_label", branch=~"$branch"} | kind="model_call" | label_format session_label=`{{ if .session_label }}{{ .session_label }}{{ else }}{{ substr 0 8 .session_id }}{{ end }}` | input_tokens != "" | output_tokens != "" | cache_read_tokens != "" | cache_write_tokens != "" | label_format total_tokens="{{ add .input_tokens .output_tokens .cache_read_tokens .cache_write_tokens }}" | unwrap total_tokens [5m])) or (sum(count_over_time({service_name=~".+", agent=~"$agent", project=~"$project", session_id=~"$session_id", run_id=~"$run_id", task=~"$task", variant=~"$variant", session_label=~"$session_label", branch=~"$branch"} | kind="model_call" [5m])) * 0)) / 5

panels.title: Active Sessions, right now
panels.description: Counts the distinct session_id values emitting any Event in the trailing 5 minutes, the same fixed window the two rate stats on this row use, so all three numbers describe the same "right now".

targets.expr: count(count by (session_id) (count_over_time({service_name=~".+", agent=~"$agent", project=~"$project", session_id=~"$session_id", run_id=~"$run_id", task=~"$task", variant=~"$variant", session_label=~"$session_label", branch=~"$branch"} [5m])))

panels.title: Money, extrapolated per hour
panels.description: The sum of cost_usd on kind=model_call Events in the trailing 15 minutes, multiplied by four to extrapolate a dollars-per-hour figure, across every active Session that matches the pickers. Only about 96 of 28596 model_call Events in the captured data carry cost_usd at all, so this stat is frequently empty or reads a true zero; that is honest, not a bug, and no price table is invented to fill the gap. The `or (... * 0)` term reports a true zero when no call in the window carries cost_usd, and the noValue field reads `no spend yet` instead of "No data" when Loki returns no matching stream at all. If the stored Events include a replayed capture, several model_call Events share one near-identical timestamp, so an extrapolated dollars-per-hour figure over that stretch can read far higher than any live Session could spend; the same panel reads correctly once a live Session is running.

targets.expr: (sum(sum_over_time({service_name=~".+", agent=~"$agent", project=~"$project", session_id=~"$session_id", run_id=~"$run_id", task=~"$task", variant=~"$variant", session_label=~"$session_label", branch=~"$branch"} | kind="model_call" | unwrap cost_usd [15m])) or (sum(count_over_time({service_name=~".+", agent=~"$agent", project=~"$project", session_id=~"$session_id", run_id=~"$run_id", task=~"$task", variant=~"$variant", session_label=~"$session_label", branch=~"$branch"} | kind="model_call" [15m])) * 0)) * 4

panels.title: Tokens per minute, by Session
panels.description: The sum of input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read_tokens and cache_write_tokens on kind=model_call Events in each $__interval window, one series per session_label, divided by the window length in minutes so the figure is a genuine per-minute rate. A Session with no session_label is shown under the first 8 characters of its session_id instead, so one runaway Session still stands out by name. If the stored Events include a replayed capture, many log lines share one near-identical timestamp and land in the same $__interval bucket, so this panel can read in the tens of millions over a historical window; the figure is correct once read against a live Session.

targets.expr: sum by (session_label) (sum_over_time({service_name=~".+", agent=~"$agent", project=~"$project", session_id=~"$session_id", run_id=~"$run_id", task=~"$task", variant=~"$variant", session_label=~"$session_label", branch=~"$branch"} | kind="model_call" | label_format session_label=`{{ if .session_label }}{{ .session_label }}{{ else }}{{ substr 0 8 .session_id }}{{ end }}` | input_tokens != "" | output_tokens != "" | cache_read_tokens != "" | cache_write_tokens != "" | label_format total_tokens="{{ add .input_tokens .output_tokens .cache_read_tokens .cache_write_tokens }}" | unwrap total_tokens [$__interval])) / ($__interval_ms / 60000)

panels.title: Input, output, cache-read and cache-write tokens, stacked
panels.description: The sum of input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read_tokens and cache_write_tokens on kind=model_call Events in each $__interval window, four stacked series, across every active Session that matches the pickers, so which kind of token dominates the current burn is visible at a glance.

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({service_name=~".+", agent=~"$agent", project=~"$project", session_id=~"$session_id", run_id=~"$run_id", task=~"$task", variant=~"$variant", session_label=~"$session_label", branch=~"$branch"} | kind="model_call" | input_tokens != "" | unwrap input_tokens [$__interval]))

sum(sum_over_time({service_name=~".+", agent=~"$agent", project=~"$project", session_id=~"$session_id", run_id=~"$run_id", task=~"$task", variant=~"$variant", session_label=~"$session_label", branch=~"$branch"} | kind="model_call" | output_tokens != "" | unwrap output_tokens [$__interval]))

sum(sum_over_time({service_name=~".+", agent=~"$agent", project=~"$project", session_id=~"$session_id", run_id=~"$run_id", task=~"$task", variant=~"$variant", session_label=~"$session_label", branch=~"$branch"} | kind="model_call" | cache_read_tokens != "" | unwrap cache_read_tokens [$__interval]))

sum(sum_over_time({service_name=~".+", agent=~"$agent", project=~"$project", session_id=~"$session_id", run_id=~"$run_id", task=~"$task", variant=~"$variant", session_label=~"$session_label", branch=~"$branch"} | kind="model_call" | cache_write_tokens != "" | unwrap cache_write_tokens [$__interval]))

panels.title: Cache-read share of input-side tokens
panels.description: cache_read_tokens divided by the sum of cache_read_tokens, input_tokens and cache_write_tokens, summed over kind=model_call Events in the selected range, as a true 0-100% share, so the operator can tell whether the cache is working right now rather than paying full price for repeated context.

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({service_name=~".+", agent=~"$agent", project=~"$project", session_id=~"$session_id", run_id=~"$run_id", task=~"$task", variant=~"$variant", session_label=~"$session_label", branch=~"$branch"} | kind="model_call" | cache_read_tokens != "" | unwrap cache_read_tokens [$__range])) / (sum(sum_over_time({service_name=~".+", agent=~"$agent", project=~"$project", session_id=~"$session_id", run_id=~"$run_id", task=~"$task", variant=~"$variant", session_label=~"$session_label", branch=~"$branch"} | kind="model_call" | cache_read_tokens != "" | unwrap cache_read_tokens [$__range])) + sum(sum_over_time({service_name=~".+", agent=~"$agent", project=~"$project", session_id=~"$session_id", run_id=~"$run_id", task=~"$task", variant=~"$variant", session_label=~"$session_label", branch=~"$branch"} | kind="model_call" | input_tokens != "" | unwrap input_tokens [$__range])) + sum(sum_over_time({service_name=~".+", agent=~"$agent", project=~"$project", session_id=~"$session_id", run_id=~"$run_id", task=~"$task", variant=~"$variant", session_label=~"$session_label", branch=~"$branch"} | kind="model_call" | cache_write_tokens != "" | unwrap cache_write_tokens [$__range])))

panels.title: Tokens by model
panels.description: The sum of input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read_tokens and cache_write_tokens on kind=model_call Events in the selected range, grouped by model, as a horizontal bar chart, so an expensive model stands out from a cheap one.

targets.expr: sum by (model) (sum_over_time({service_name=~".+", agent=~"$agent", project=~"$project", session_id=~"$session_id", run_id=~"$run_id", task=~"$task", variant=~"$variant", session_label=~"$session_label", branch=~"$branch"} | kind="model_call" | label_format session_label=`{{ if .session_label }}{{ .session_label }}{{ else }}{{ substr 0 8 .session_id }}{{ end }}` | input_tokens != "" | output_tokens != "" | cache_read_tokens != "" | cache_write_tokens != "" | label_format total_tokens="{{ add .input_tokens .output_tokens .cache_read_tokens .cache_write_tokens }}" | unwrap total_tokens [$__range]))

panels.title: Per-Session burn, in the selected range
panels.description: One row per session_label (falling back to the first 8 characters of session_id when the label is empty): tokens so far, the sum of input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read_tokens and cache_write_tokens on kind=model_call Events; and cost so far, the sum of cost_usd. Claude Code's own Events do not emit a cost_usd field at all, so cost so far is blank for a Claude Code Session; it fills only once a Run records an Event that carries cost_usd. Both targets are instant queries taken at the same moment, so the join also carries one Time column repeating that single identical instant on every row; it is dropped here as noise, not data.

targets.expr: sum by (session_label) (sum_over_time({service_name=~".+", agent=~"$agent", project=~"$project", session_id=~"$session_id", run_id=~"$run_id", task=~"$task", variant=~"$variant", session_label=~"$session_label", branch=~"$branch"} | kind="model_call" | label_format session_label=`{{ if .session_label }}{{ .session_label }}{{ else }}{{ substr 0 8 .session_id }}{{ end }}` | input_tokens != "" | output_tokens != "" | cache_read_tokens != "" | cache_write_tokens != "" | label_format total_tokens="{{ add .input_tokens .output_tokens .cache_read_tokens .cache_write_tokens }}" | unwrap total_tokens [$__range]))

sum by (session_label) (sum_over_time({service_name=~".+", agent=~"$agent", project=~"$project", session_id=~"$session_id", run_id=~"$run_id", task=~"$task", variant=~"$variant", session_label=~"$session_label", branch=~"$branch"} | kind="model_call" | label_format session_label=`{{ if .session_label }}{{ .session_label }}{{ else }}{{ substr 0 8 .session_id }}{{ end }}` | unwrap cost_usd [$__range]))

panels.title: Cumulative money spent, since the window began
panels.description: The running total of cost_usd summed over kind=model_call Events, across every active Session that matches the pickers, using a cumulative-sum field calculation over the per-interval sum, in the selected range. Claude Code's own Events do not emit a cost_usd field at all, so this line stays at the noValue reading `no cost recorded` for a Claude Code Session; it fills only once a Run records an Event that carries cost_usd.

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({service_name=~".+", agent=~"$agent", project=~"$project", session_id=~"$session_id", run_id=~"$run_id", task=~"$task", variant=~"$variant", session_label=~"$session_label", branch=~"$branch"} | kind="model_call" | unwrap cost_usd [$__interval]))

panels.title: Reasoning tokens per minute, by model
panels.description: The sum of reasoning_tokens on kind=model_call Events over each $__interval window, one series per model, divided by the window length in minutes, so a reasoning-heavy model that quietly drives up the burn rate stands out. A model that never reports reasoning_tokens is absent from this panel rather than shown at zero. The same replayed-capture clustering that inflates the token-per-minute panels on this board applies here too: a historical window can read unrealistically high, and the figure is correct once read against a live Session.

targets.expr: sum by (model) (sum_over_time({service_name=~".+", agent=~"$agent", project=~"$project", session_id=~"$session_id", run_id=~"$run_id", task=~"$task", variant=~"$variant", session_label=~"$session_label", branch=~"$branch"} | kind="model_call" | reasoning_tokens != "" | unwrap reasoning_tokens [$__interval])) / ($__interval_ms / 60000)

panels.title: Most expensive model call in the window
panels.description: Reads kind=model_call Events that carry cost_usd as raw log lines, a range query over the selected range, sorted by cost_usd descending and limited to the single most expensive call, with its model, duration_ms and Session shown alongside, falling back to the first 8 characters of session_id when session_label is empty. Shown as a one-row table rather than a stat, because a stat panel has no way to tie one field's maximum to another field on the same Event. Only about 96 of 28596 model_call Events carry cost_usd, so this table is frequently empty; that is honest, not a bug. The noValue field reads `no spend yet` instead of "No data" when no Event in the selected range carries cost_usd.

targets.expr: {service_name=~".+", agent=~"$agent", project=~"$project", session_id=~"$session_id", run_id=~"$run_id", task=~"$task", variant=~"$variant", session_label=~"$session_label", branch=~"$branch"} | kind="model_call" | label_format session_label=`{{ if .session_label }}{{ .session_label }}{{ else }}{{ substr 0 8 .session_id }}{{ end }}` | cost_usd != ""

panels.title: Cost by model, in the selected range
panels.description: The sum of cost_usd on kind=model_call Events in the selected range, grouped by model, as a horizontal bar chart, so an expensive model stands out by price rather than only by token count. Claude Code's own Events do not emit a cost_usd field at all, so this chart stays at the noValue reading `no cost recorded` for a Claude Code Session; it fills only once a Run records an Event that carries cost_usd.

targets.expr: sum by (model) (sum_over_time({service_name=~".+", agent=~"$agent", project=~"$project", session_id=~"$session_id", run_id=~"$run_id", task=~"$task", variant=~"$variant", session_label=~"$session_label", branch=~"$branch"} | kind="model_call" | unwrap cost_usd [$__range]))
